**BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge** is a clinical facility operating under the BUA umbrella at [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien]]. It is a key entity in the landscape of Danish child and adolescent psychiatry, frequently referenced in national quality and database reports regarding ADHD diagnostics and treatment workflows in Region Midtjylland.

The clinic is notable for its impact on national data validation practices. Between April 1, 2024, and March 31, 2025, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge registered 31 discarded assessment courses (*afkræftede udredningsforløb*) [^src1]. This specific volume of discarded cases contributes significantly to the regional variation in the application of the AGX01B marker, a technical indicator used by the ADHD database to exclude non-relevant assessments from official statistics. 

Furthermore, the clinic's performance highlights broader systemic challenges in cross-sectoral psychiatric care. When evaluating Indicator 4—which mandates that a coordinating network meeting must occur within 90 days—departmental data for units handling more than 10 courses showed that BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge achieved a target fulfillment rate of only [[1-percent|1-percent]] [^src2]. This extremely low compliance rate mirrors a nationwide structural struggle, as no region or department in the country successfully meets the 90% standard for this indicator, pointing to pressed resources and coordination deficits in the sector.
